name: bonk-smoke-overhead-chop
notes: PIPELINE SMOKE TEST, not a game move: it checks that the current-character rig pack works end to end.
character: Bonk (55 joints, five fingers; a 1.84 m greatsword fixed to the right hand as joint Weapon0 with bladeHilt and bladeEnd anchors)
description: A two-handed overhead greatsword chop from the idle stance. Ticks 1-12 lift the sword overhead with both arms, the blade pointing back over the shoulders. Ticks 13-15 hold the loaded pose. Ticks 16-18 chop down in front of the body; contact at tick 18 with the blade roughly horizontal and pointing forward at about waist height. Ticks 19-24 follow through slightly lower and decelerate. Ticks 25-39 recover to the idle pose; ticks 40-48 equal the idle entry pose exactly. The left hand comes up in front of the chest and takes the grip below the right hand by tick 6; both hands hold the hilt through the lift, the chop and the follow-through (ticks 6-24), then the left hand returns to its idle place. Both feet stay planted. The blade must not cut into the ground or the body.
image_notes: 1: the idle entry pose with the greatsword (profile, front, three-quarter rear angle). 2: Bonk's own two-handed grip, from his Charging Double Slash (front, three-quarter, profile).
